patches.name: Disable tracking and analytics
patches.description: Turns off Adjust, Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics, Facebook app events and the unused ad SDKs. None of them are useful on a private server.

patches.name: Redirect to private server
patches.description: Redirects all network traffic to a private server and routes in-app purchases to it, since the official servers and store shut down in 2024.

options.description: http also enables cleartext traffic in the manifest and turns the game's TLS off for gRPC. https keeps TLS on, so the server needs a certificate the game trusts (e.g. behind Cloudflare).
Hostname or IP of your server, without protocol or port.
Leave empty for the default port (80 or 443 depending on protocol).
Only change this if your server uses a non-standard gRPC port.

patches.name: Roulette without ads
patches.description: The daily gem roulette spins straight away instead of playing an IronSource video ad, and the IronSource SDK never starts.
